note: Apple's 'Surprise and Shine' event is today, expected to unveil the first foldable iPhone.

front.title: OpenAI says it cracked 90-year-old maths problem in 88 hours
front.tldr: OpenAI says an unreleased model resolved the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize problem in under four days, but mathematicians and rivals dispute how much credit the company deserves.

front.title: 'Bunker' dazzles Venice with a record 15.5-minute ovation for Penélope Cruz and Javier Bardem
front.tldr: Penélope Cruz and Javier Bardem's new thriller received a 15.5-minute standing ovation at its Venice premiere, one of the festival's longest. Cruz was seen in tears embracing her husband and co-star.

front.title: Patriots sign CB Christian Gonzalez to record-breaking contract extension
front.tldr: The Patriots agreed a four-year, $135 million extension with cornerback Christian Gonzalez, making him the highest-paid corner in NFL history, a day before New England's season opener against Seattle.

stories.title: Cognition hits $48 billion valuation as AI coding investors bet against a winner-take-all market
stories.tldr: Coding startup Cognition raised at a $48 billion valuation, a higher multiple than Cursor's before its sale, suggesting investors expect several AI coding tools to coexist rather than one clear winner.

stories.title: Mistral raises €3 billion as sovereign AI becomes big business
stories.tldr: French AI lab Mistral raised €3 billion at a €21 billion valuation in a round led by Samsung, Scaleup Europe and PSG Equity, underlining investor appetite for AI built outside the US.

stories.title: DeepMind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA letter change in the human genome
stories.tldr: Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome Atlas, mapping the molecular effects of 9 billion single-letter DNA variants across the human genome, a resource intended to speed up disease research.

stories.title: Meta launches Muse, a personal AI agent with access to email, calendars and payments
stories.tldr: Meta's new Muse app is a personal AI agent that can access users' email, calendars, payments and health services, the company's biggest consumer AI bet yet, testing how much people will hand over.

stories.title: CloudNC raises $20 million to automate manufacturing bottlenecks
stories.tldr: UK manufacturing software startup CloudNC raised a $20 million extension round, taking its lifetime funding to $128 million, to keep automating factory production bottlenecks.

stories.title: Stoke Space raises another $1 billion to rival SpaceX at reflying rockets
stories.tldr: Rocket startup Stoke Space closed the first tranche of a $1 billion Series E to reach orbit and build a larger, fully reusable rocket, aiming to compete directly with SpaceX.

stories.title: The Exploration Company raises $450 million to challenge SpaceX
stories.tldr: French startup The Exploration Company raised $450 million, the largest-ever Series C by a European space company, to build reusable spacecraft.

stories.title: Google's revived Iowa nuclear plant gets $1.9 billion US government loan
stories.tldr: The Iowa nuclear plant Google pledged to bring back online has secured a $1.9 billion loan from the US Energy Department, backing the tech industry's push for more power to run AI.

stories.title: AirPods turn 10 years old
stories.tldr: Apple unveiled the first AirPods on 7 September 2016, though they did not go on sale until that December, marking a decade of the wireless earbuds that reshaped the category.

stories.title: Apple reportedly set to unveil a new 'Readiness' app today
stories.tldr: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple plans to unveil a new 'Readiness' app at today's event, according to a social media post. Apple has not confirmed this itself.

stories.title: iPhone Ultra is coming, according to the final rumours before today's Apple event
stories.tldr: 9to5Mac rounds up last-minute reports ahead of today's Apple event, where the company is expected to announce its first foldable iPhone, said to be called the iPhone Ultra. This is a report, not a confirmed fact.

stories.title: Apple Watch SE 3 goes unavailable ahead of today's event
stories.tldr: Nearly every configuration of the Apple Watch SE 3 has disappeared from Apple's online store in the US and elsewhere, for reasons unknown, hours before today's product event.

stories.title: Summer box office hits an all-time high in 2026
stories.tldr: The 2026 summer box office reached $4.765 billion, a record, powered as much by Spider-Man and Christopher Nolan as by Obsession and A24, according to IndieWire's takeaways.

stories.title: Original Star Wars heads to IMAX for the saga's 50th anniversary
stories.tldr: The 1977 original Star Wars will get an IMAX theatrical release in 2027 to mark the saga's 50th anniversary, /Film reports.

stories.title: Telluride festival takeaways: Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti and Nathan Fielder's awards contenders
stories.tldr: Variety's Telluride wrap highlights Julianne Moore and Paul Giamatti's Debut and Nathan Fielder's documentary dare as early contenders heading into awards season, with Toronto up next.

stories.title: Casey Affleck's 'Company' gets a four-minute standing ovation at Venice
stories.tldr: Casey Affleck's gothic thriller Company received a four-minute standing ovation at its Venice premiere, with Nick Nolte and Ben Affleck among those on hand. Reviews of the film have been mixed.

stories.title: CelticsBlog sizes up young Celtics players who could break out next season
stories.tldr: CelticsBlog runs through Boston's young core, including Baylor Scheierman, Hugo Gonzalez, Jordan Walsh, Ron Harper Jr. and Amari Williams, weighing who could take a step forward in 2026-27.

stories.title: Patriots rule out RB TreVeyon Henderson for season opener with ankle injury
stories.tldr: Running back TreVeyon Henderson, who racked up over 1,100 all-purpose yards as a rookie, has been ruled out for tonight's season opener against Seattle after missing all three practices this week.

stories.title: Patriots say revenge is not on their minds for Super Bowl rematch with Seahawks
stories.tldr: New England face Seattle tonight, 214 days after their Super Bowl loss to the Seahawks, in a season-opening rematch at Lumen Field.

stories.title: McLaren to review team orders after Norris accuses Piastri of forcing him off track
stories.tldr: McLaren says it will review its rules of engagement between Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri after Norris accused his teammate of forcing him off track at the Italian Grand Prix.

stories.title: Toto Wolff likens Kimi Antonelli to an 'AI agent' that keeps improving
stories.tldr: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff says he has been surprised by Kimi Antonelli's rapid growth this season, comparing the rookie to an AI agent that is constantly getting better.

stories.title: Vettel reflects on driving Schumacher's title-winning Ferrari
stories.tldr: Sebastian Vettel called it 'a very emotional moment' to drive Michael Schumacher's 2002 title-winning Ferrari F2002 ahead of last weekend's Italian Grand Prix.

stories.title: Angels end Red Sox win streak with 6-1 victory behind Reid Detmers' 9 strikeouts
stories.tldr: Reid Detmers struck out nine as the Angels beat Boston 6-1, outhitting the Red Sox 15-4 to end their winning streak and secure just their third win in 15 games.

stories.title: Garrett Crochet throws second side session, could return in relief role for playoffs
stories.tldr: Garrett Crochet completed a second side session and the Red Sox are hopeful he could pitch out of the bullpen if Boston reaches the postseason.

read.why: Today's news is full of AI agents, from Meta's Muse to Antonelli being compared to one, so a framework for telling a useful one from hype feels timely.
read.title: Not all AI agents are created equal

finally.title: A new book celebrates the world of fungi in over 200 works
finally.tldr: Phaidon's next survey book, following volumes on butterflies, birds, oceans and trees, turns its attention to fungi this October, gathering more than 200 works on the subject.
